config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.expup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "explicit-secret"

[[models]]
name = "shared"
provider = "expup"
model = "explicit-up"
enabled = false

[llama_cpp]
timeout = 2
refresh_seconds = 0
prefix = ""
aliases = true
compatibility = "strict"
servers = [{url="{UPSTREAM}", name="localup", api_key="fake"}]
name: m4_llama_disabled_reserved
